About this species: Zygophyllum molle is a low desert subshrub found in dry sandy and gravelly habitats from Egypt to nearby Middle Eastern regions. It is adapted to drought through its compact form and water-conserving tissues. The plant contributes to the perennial vegetation cover of arid landscapes and may be useful for recognizing regional desert plant communities. Because its taxonomic treatment may vary among sources, the accepted name and synonyms should be checked carefully in scientific datasets.
